subject: oop
question: What is the significance of a protected variable?
title: Protected = Family
hook: Strangers can't see the recipe. Family can.
answer: A protected variable is accessible within its own class and within other classes of the same package.
It is also accessible in subclasses, even when they are in a different package.
Its significance is inheritance: a parent shares data with its children.
It is not public, so the rest of the world cannot touch it.
